title: Nebula Drift
summary: Nebula Drift - top-down arena survival shooter with momentum thrust and dash, 4 enemy types incl. a boss every 5th wave, energy-orb charged screen-clearing pulse, combo multiplier, power-up drops (repair/rapid/charge), particle VFX, screen shake, procedural animated sprites, and dependency-free synth audio
controls: WASD/arrows thrust, mouse aim, left click/Space fire, Shift/RMB dash, E/MMB energy pulse, Enter/Space start-restart, Esc quit
audio: pre-rendered WAV synth clips played via macOS afplay (no audio crates)

tests.e2e: tests/binary_e2e.rs runs the shipped binary with --selftest (headless sim + render for 400 simulated seconds)

learnings_from_previous_day: added a clear on-screen lives/health UI (previous game had none)
the 'unexplained red line' is replaced by a clearly framed cyan arena border
frame ghosting fixed by fully clearing the framebuffer every frame (asserted in tests)
